info.title: OneTrace.pro API
info.description: Public API v1: event ingestion (write keys) and project management (secret keys with permissions). Errors are `{"message": "..."}`; validation errors add `errors` by field path. Lists use cursor pagination (`limit` 1-200, `cursor` from `next_cursor`). POST requests accept an `Idempotency-Key` header: a repeat with the same key and body returns the stored response for 24 hours. Rate limits: 6000 requests/min per write key, 1200 requests/min per secret key (`429`). Error messages follow `Accept-Language` (en, ru, de, es, fr, it, pt, tr, uz, zh), otherwise the platform default language.

Takes points off the balance (earliest expiring first) and holds them for 30 minutes while the order is placed. A new hold for the same `cart_id` returns the previous one. With `amount`, points are limited to the payable share of the cart. Confirm with the order number or cancel; unconfirmed holds return automatically.

Requires key permission(s): `loyalty.write`.

Requires key permission(s): `loyalty.write`.

Returns the points of a hold or a confirmed redemption to the balance (into their original lots while they have not expired).

Adds points (a lot available at once, with the program lifetime) or takes them off the balance (not more than available), with a reason recorded in the history and the audit log. Send `Idempotency-Key` to make retries safe.

post.description:
Sends one message to one profile right away — an order confirmation, a password reset, a one-time code. The recipient profile is found by identity or created. Repeat the request with the same `Idempotency-Key` to retry safely: no second message is sent. No more than `MESSAGES_API_PER_RECIPIENT_PER_HOUR` (20 by default) messages per recipient per hour through the API. Poll `GET /messages/{message}` for the delivery status. With `steps`, the message goes as a cascade — poll `GET /messages/cascades/{cascade}`; the per-recipient limit counts a cascade once; without the `cascades` plan feature the answer is `402`.

Requires key permission(s): `messages.send`.

202.description: Queued: a message, or a cascade when `steps` are given

post.description:
Sends a ready email of an online store — an order confirmation, an invoice, a password reset — through the project's email integration as is, without a template. The email goes to `to` as a transactional message: no marketing consent or frequency rules, but bounced and complained addresses are blocked. It is counted in the monthly message quota. The answer is fast: when it is not `202` (no email integration, quota exhausted, the service is unavailable), send the email yourself. Repeat the request with the same `Idempotency-Key` to retry safely. No more than `MESSAGES_STORE_EMAILS_PER_RECIPIENT_PER_HOUR` (30 by default) store emails per recipient per hour. Order emails (`order_*` kinds) with `order` are built from the OneTrace template enabled for the kind, in the customer `language`; without an enabled template `subject` and `html` are required. Poll `GET /messages/{message}` for the delivery status.

Requires key permission(s): `messages.send`.

get.description: Topics of the preference center with names and descriptions in the project languages. Requires key permission(s): `profiles.read`.

writeKey.description: `cdp_wk_…`: ingestion only. Also accepted as Basic auth user or `writeKey` body field.

secretKey.description: `cdp_sk_…`: server-side only, permissions chosen when the key is created.

IdentityValue.name: value
IdentityValue.description: Normalized like at ingestion (lower-case email, E.164 phone).

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description: Repeat-safe retries: same key and body return the stored response (header `Idempotent-Replayed: true`); a different body gives 422; a request still in progress gives 409.

RedemptionId.name: redemption
RedemptionId.description: Redemption id from the hold response.

PromoPoolKey.name: key
PromoPoolKey.description: Pool key — the name used in templates: `{{ promo_code('summer') }}`.

Forbidden.description: The key lacks the required permission or the brand is suspended

NotFound.description: Not found in the key's project

TooManyRequests.description: Rate limit or monthly event quota exceeded

Error.description: The request cannot be applied in the current state

consents.description: identify only, secret key only: marketing consents given together with the customer data (sign-up or checkout form). Unknown channels are skipped.

topic.description: Subscription topic; the whole channel if omitted.

segment_ids.description: Members of any of these segments get the campaign.

exclude_segment_ids.description: Members of these segments are excluded.

template_id.description: Message template of the campaign channel.

percent.description: Share of the audience (or of the A/B test share); all variants add up to 100.

CampaignAb.description: A/B test: `test_percent` of the audience is split between variants; after `wait` the rest gets the winner by `metric`.

CampaignSchedule.description: Times are wall-clock in the project time zone; with `local_time` — in each recipient's `timezone` trait.

CampaignGoal.description: Conversion: the event from the recipient within the window after sending.

integration_id.description: Channel integration; the template of every variant must belong to its channel.

converted.description: Recipients with the goal event in the window; null without a goal.

ab_result.description: Test result saved when the A/B winner was picked.

languages.description: Results per language of the sent template version.

AbStats.description: Significance of the difference between variants (docs/architecture/analytics.md#значимость-ab); null with one variant.

winner.description: Set only when the best variant is significantly better than every other one.

p_value.description: Holm-adjusted p-value against the best variant

image.description: JPEG up to image_width via imgproxy; without imgproxy — a direct link (CDN copy or feed URL).

image_original.description: Direct link: the platform CDN copy if the feed mirrors images, otherwise the feed URL.

srcset.description: Variants for <picture>: AVIF and WebP srcset (240–960 px); null without imgproxy.

min_quantity.description: The product is sold as a set (tires by 4): how many to add to the cart; null — one.

id.description: Product id on the site: product_id in events.

stock.description: Units in stock. Used only when "Use stock levels from the API and plugins" is on in the catalog settings of the project: then the stock is saved, zero takes the product off sale, and the "low stock" journey trigger works. Otherwise it is ignored.

translations.description: Translations by language (BCP 47 tag → text), ADR-080: name, url and params in that language; they are shown to visitors and in messages of the language. Languages sent before are kept, a new one is added.

topic.description: Subscription topic the message belongs to.

language.description: Main language of `content`: recipients whose profile language has no version get it.

content.description: Fields of the channel message schema, e.g. `subject`, `html` and `text` for email; string fields are Twig templates.

translations.description: Other language versions: language tag → content. A recipient gets the version for the `language` profile trait (exact tag, then the base language, then another variant of it), otherwise `content`.

version.description: Grows when any language version changes.

channel_key.description: Channel of the template; cannot be changed later.

language.description: Main language of `content`; the project default language if omitted.

content.description: Fields of the channel message schema, e.g. `subject`, `html` and `text` for email; string fields are Twig templates.

translations.description: Other language versions; each is validated like `content`. Omit to keep the stored versions, pass `{}` to delete them.

last.description: Last N days including today, in the project timezone

oneOf.description: Dates in the project timezone, up to 731 days

key.description: Property key from the event catalog

operator.description: Operator of the property type, as in segment rules

value.description: Value for the operator; absent for is_set / is_not_set

ProfileRules.description: Segment rules (docs/architecture/segmentation.md): only events of matching profiles are counted. Null or an empty group — all profiles.

key.description: Event property, or a page field: page.path, page.referrer, campaign.source, campaign.medium, campaign.name, locale

window.description: Conversion window from the first step, up to 90 days

periods.description: Up to 30 days, 12 weeks or 12 months

event.description: Purchase event; by default from the prediction settings

series.description: Per series: index, total, values per bucket, previous period, breakdown

steps.description: Per step: event, reached, from_start, from_previous, median_seconds, avg_seconds

breakdown.description: Per breakdown value: value, steps (reached per step)

time_sample.description: Share of profiles used for time between steps

cohorts.description: Per cohort: date, size, values (returned per period, null — not yet), open (period still running)

channels.description: Per channel: channel, clicks, touched_orders, revenue and orders by model

items.description: Per campaign, journey, message channel or widget

view.description: Page view settings: chart type, metric

definition.description: Definition of the report type — see the run operations

pending.description: Points waiting for the return period

referral_code.description: Code of the member for inviting friends.

referral_url.description: Referral link (`?ref=` on the store page) when referrals are on.

referrals.description: Friends who came with the code, of them rewarded, and points for them.

referral.description: Referral reward: `friend` — for joining by invitation, `referrer` — for the first order of a friend.

type.description: `shared` — one code for everyone; `unique` — a separate code for every profile.

active.description: Active now: not paused and within the promotion period.

discount.description: Discount text for messages, e.g. «−10 %». The discount itself is a coupon rule of the store.

validity_days.description: A code is valid for this many days after it is issued (not longer than the promotion).

per_profile.description: How many codes of the pool one profile can receive.

revenue.description: Sum of the orders with codes of the pool.

status.description: `pending` — waiting for the friend's first order.

rewarded.description: The friend has received the reward.

expires_at.description: The first order of the friend rewards the member until this moment.

identity.description: The recipient. A profile with this identity is created if there is none.

traits.description: Traits written to the profile before sending, available in the template as `traits.*`.

template_id.description: Message template. A transactional template skips consents, frequency limits and quiet hours, but not hard blocks of the channel (address does not exist, bot blocked); other templates follow all messaging rules.

integration_id.description: Channel integration of the template's channel; may be omitted when the channel has exactly one active integration.

data.description: Per-message data, available in the template as `context.data.*` (order number, confirmation code).

steps.description: Cascade (plans with the `cascades` feature): channels tried in order — the next one when the profile cannot be reached on the previous, or its message was not sent, not delivered or not read within the step time.

MessageSendInput.description: Pass `template_id` (and `integration_id` if needed) for one message, or `steps` for a cascade — not both.

status.description: `queued` → `sent` → `delivered`; `scheduled` — waiting (quiet hours, warm-up); `skipped` — not sent, see `reason`; `failed`/`bounced` — see `reason` and `error`.

reason.description: Why it was skipped or failed: `no_recipient`, `unsubscribed`, `recipient_blocked`, `suppressed`, `frequency_limit`, `quota_exceeded`, `feature_unavailable`, `delivery_failed`, `recipient_unreachable`, `undelivered`, `template_error`, `integration_unavailable` …

origin.description: `api` for messages sent with `messages.send`, `store` for store emails (`emails.send`).

wait_for.description: What counts as success. `delivered` needs an integration that reports delivery (not email through own SMTP), `opened` — a channel that reports reading (email, WhatsApp, Viber).

timeout.description: How long to wait for `delivered` or `opened` after sending; 15 minutes by default.

status.description: `reached` — a step succeeded; `failed` — no channel reached the profile.

messages.description: Messages of the steps tried so far.

bot.description: Reply of the AI bot; operator holds the bot name

token.description: Returned for a new conversation or when the request had no valid token; store it

bot.description: The AI bot leads the conversation: the widget offers to call an operator (POST /chat/handoff)

channel.description: `web` — the website chat; messengers need the `chat_messengers` plan feature.

status.description: `open` — the customer wrote last and waits for an answer; `waiting` — answered, waiting for the customer; `closed`.

assigned.description: An operator is responsible for the conversation.

unread_count.description: Customer messages operators have not read yet.

author.description: `visitor` — the customer; `operator` — an answer from the inbox or the API; `system` — assignment, closing and reopening (see `action`).

via.description: Where an answer or action came from: the operator inbox or the API.

api_key.description: Name of the API key that answered or closed the conversation.

status.description: Delivery status of an answer sent to a messenger: queued, sent, delivered, failed, skipped, bounced.

to.description: Recipient address. The profile is found by this email or created.

subject.description: Required unless an order template is enabled for `kind` and `order` is given.

html.description: Ready HTML of the store email. Sent as is: it is not a template, braces are not processed. Required unless an order template is enabled for `kind` and `order` is given.

text.description: Plain-text part; built from the HTML when empty.

reply_to.description: Overrides the Reply-To of the email integration.

from_name.description: Overrides the sender name of the email integration; the sender address is always the integration's.

kind.description: What the email is: `order_placed`, `order_paid`, `order_shipped`, `order_delivered`, `order_cancelled`, `order_refunded`, `account_new`, `password_reset`, `email_verification`, `login_link`, `login_code`, `other` … Access-link kinds (`password_reset`, `account_new`, `email_verification`, `login_link`, `login_code`) go without click tracking, and only the subject is kept after sending. For `order_placed`, `order_paid`, `order_shipped`, `order_delivered`, `order_cancelled`, `order_refunded` with `order`, an enabled OneTrace template builds the email instead of `html` (see `GET /emails/settings`).

language.description: Customer language tag: picks the language version of an order template; for history and reports otherwise.

integration_id.description: Email integration; may be omitted when the project has exactly one active.

traits.description: Profile traits to update before sending (name, phone).

attachments.description: Up to 5 files, 5 MB in total.

template.description: The email is built from a OneTrace order template.

StoreOrder.description: Order data for order email templates — the `order` template variable.

number.description: Number shown to the customer; `order_id` when empty.

payment_instructions.description: Bank transfer details and similar instructions.

total.description: Line total; price × quantity when empty.

options.description: Variant options as text: «Size: M, colour: white».

relay.description: Send all store emails through OneTrace (store emails section).

templates.description: Order email kinds built from OneTrace templates: the store does not send its own email for them and passes `order` instead.

status.description: `error` — see `error`; the bot works without this server

tools.description: Contract tools the bot may use

ProfilePreferences.description: Subscription preferences of a profile (preference center): topics by channel, frequency and pause of marketing messages.

channels.description: Channels the profile receives or can receive messages in: channels of its consents and messages of the last year, and channels of active integrations it has an address for.

blocked.description: Hard block (the address does not exist, the bot was stopped): read only.

channels.description: Channel key → subscribed (`true`/`false`), `null` — the topic is not offered in this channel.

frequency.description: At most one marketing message per week or month across channels; `null` — as usual.

paused_until.description: Marketing messages are paused until this time.

preferences_url.description: Signed link to the preference center page of this profile, valid for 30 days — for a «Manage subscriptions» link in the store account.
